# Explore Pune

> The Curated Field Guide to Historic Pune — Maratha hill fortresses, Peshwa-era wadas, ancient Hemadpanthi sanctuaries, cultural museums, Sahyadri trekking trails, and local cuisine.

Explore Pune is an authoritative, verified digital travel journal, itinerary planner, and heritage preservation directory dedicated to Pune and the surrounding Sahyadri region in Maharashtra, India.

- **Canonical Domain**: https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app
- **Languages**: English (`en-IN`) and Marathi (`mr-IN`)
- **Full LLM Knowledge Directory**: https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/llms-full.txt
- **Primary Sitemap**: https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- **Robots Policy**: https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Primary Public Exploration Routes
- [Explore Pune Home](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/): Main heritage explorer directory with real-time category filtering, search, and 106+ field-verified destinations.
- [Destinations Field Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations): Complete verified catalog of 106+ Pune heritage spots.
- [Historic Forts Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/forts): Sahyadri mountain strongholds, trekking routes, and Maratha military architecture.
- [Peshwa Wadas Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/heritage): 18th-century Maratha wadas, wooden facades, and civic monuments.
- [Sacred Temples Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/temples): Ancient Hemadpanthi, rock-cut, and sacred shrines.
- [Museums & Memorials Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/museums): Antiquities, social reform landmarks, and cultural galleries.
- [Scenic Nature & Lakes Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/nature): Sahyadri hills, tekdis, lakes, and reservoirs.
- [Culinary Heritage Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/food): Authentic Puneri gastronomy, misal, and heritage eateries.
- [Free Entry Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/destinations/free): Verified free admission destinations (₹0 entry).
- [AI Trip Planner](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/planner): Custom daily itinerary generator optimized by duration, companion, travel pace, and transit mode.
- [Interactive Website Guide](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/help/website-guide): 10-chapter notebook-style handbook teaching visitors how to explore Pune like a local.
- [Pune Community](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/community): Authentic visitor reviews, travel tips, and moderated heritage discussions.
- [Traveller Stories & Field Journals](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/blogs): Long-form travelogues and expedition field journals by local explorers.
- [Explorer Milestones](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/milestones): Gamified heritage achievements, visit certificates, and exploration badges.
- [About the Initiative](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/about): Mission, founder team, and heritage conservation ethics.
- [Data & GIS Methodology](https://explorepune-guide.vercel.app/data): Archival sources, GIS validation standards, and research methodology.

## Key Verified Entities & Factual Information
1. **Sinhagad Fort (सिंहगड किल्ला / कोंढाणा)**
   - *Location*: 30 km southwest of Pune, 1,312m elevation (18.3664° N, 73.7558° E).
   - *Significance*: Site of the 1670 Battle of Sinhagad fought by Subedar Tanaji Malusare under Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daylight hours (approx. 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM).
   - *Regulations*: Strict forest night curfew between 6:00 PM and 6:00 AM.
   - *Entry Fee*: Free admission for all pedestrian trekkers (₹0). Vehicle toll of ₹50 for two-wheelers and ₹100 for four-wheelers managed by Forest Dept / JFMC at Golewadi.
   - *Public Transit*: PMPML Bus Route 50 from Shaniwar Wada / Swargate to Sinhagad Paytha (Donje).

2. **Shaniwar Wada (शनिवार वाडा)**
   - *Location*: Shaniwar Peth, Central Pune (18.5195° N, 73.8553° E).
   - *Significance*: Imperial seat of the Peshwa rulers of the Maratha Empire, commissioned in 1730 by Peshwa Baji Rao I.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daily 8:00 AM – 6:30 PM.
   - *Entry Fee*: ₹25 for Indian citizens; ₹300 for foreign tourists (ASI regulated).
   - *Nearest Metro*: Budhwar Peth / Mandai (Purple Line) and PMC / Deccan (Aqua Line).

3. **Lal Mahal (लाल महाल)**
   - *Location*: Kasba Peth, Pune (18.5192° N, 73.8569° E).
   - *Significance*: Historic 1630 palace where young Shivaji Maharaj lived with his mother Rajmata Jijabai; location of Shivaji's encounter with Shaista Khan in 1663.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daily 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM & 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM.
   - *Entry Fee*: Nominal PMC admission (₹5 – ₹10).

4. **Pataleshwar Cave Temple (पाताळेश्वर)**
   - *Location*: Jangli Maharaj (JM) Road, Shivajinagar, Pune (18.5283° N, 73.8504° E).
   - *Significance*: 8th-century monolithic rock-cut Shiva sanctuary carved from a single basalt rock mass during the Rashtrakuta period.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daily 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM.
   - *Entry Fee*: Free entry (₹0).

5. **Shreemant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Mandir**
   - *Location*: Budhwar Peth, Pune (18.5165° N, 73.8561° E).
   - *Significance*: World-renowned Ganesh shrine established in 1893 by Dagdusheth Gadve and Lokmanya Tilak.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daily 6:00 AM – 11:00 PM.
   - *Darshan*: Free entry (₹0).

6. **Aga Khan Palace (आगाखान पॅलेस)**
   - *Location*: Nagar Road, Kalyani Nagar / Yerawada, Pune (18.5524° N, 73.9015° E).
   - *Significance*: Built in 1892 by Sultan Muhammed Shah Aga Khan III. Served as internment camp for Mahatma Gandhi, Kasturba Gandhi, and Mahadev Desai during the 1942 Quit India Movement.
   - *Visiting Hours*: Daily 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM.
   - *Entry Fee*: ₹25 for Indians, ₹300 for foreigners.

7. **Rajgad Fort (राजगड किल्ला)**
   - *Location*: 54 km southwest of Pune, 1,376m elevation (18.2464° N, 73.6822° E).
   - *Significance*: Sovereign capital of the Maratha Empire under Shivaji Maharaj for over 25 years. Features Padmavati, Suvela, and Sanjivani Machis.

8. **Torna Fort (तोरणा / प्रचंडगड)**
   - *Location*: 65 km southwest of Pune, 1,403m elevation (18.2764° N, 73.6231° E).
   - *Significance*: The first fort captured by 16-year-old Shivaji Maharaj in 1646, marking the founding of the Swarajya.

## Public Transit Guidelines (Pune Metro & PMPML)
- **Pune Metro Lines**:
  - *Purple Line (Line 1)*: PCMC Bhavan ↔ Swargate (via Shivajinagar, Civil Court interchange, Mandai).
  - *Aqua Line (Line 2)*: Vanaz (Kothrud) ↔ Ramwadi (via Nal Stop, Deccan Gymkhana, PMC, Pune Railway Station).
  - *Civil Court Interchange*: Multi-level interchange station connecting Purple and Aqua Lines.
- **PMPML Tourist Bus Pass**: ₹40 to ₹70 unlimited daily city transit passes available across PMPML bus terminals.

## Core Content Clusters
- **Cluster 1: Pune Heritage & History**: Peshwa governance, 18th-century wada architecture, Maratha defense lines, and Anglo-Maratha battles.
- **Cluster 2: Sahyadri Hill Forts & Trekking**: Trek itineraries, camping guidelines, water availability, and monsoon safety.
- **Cluster 3: Sacred Pilgrimage & Temples**: Ashtavinayak shrines (Theur, Morgaon, Siddhatek, Lenyadri, Ozar, Ranjangaon, Mahad), Alandi, Dehu, and Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga.
- **Cluster 4: Punekar Food & Culinary Culture**: Authentic Misal, Shrewsbury biscuits, Chitale Bakarwadi, Sujata Mastani, and traditional vegetarian Thalis.
- **Cluster 5: Smart Transit & Itinerary Planning**: Time-bounded exploration routes (1 hour, 2 hours, 4 hours, full day), transit connections, and budget optimization.

## Public API Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/places`: Catalog of verified published destinations with filters for category, keyword, and coordinates.
- `GET /api/v1/recommendations`: AI-powered personalized destination recommendations matching user time, budget, location, and interests.
- `GET /api/v1/health`: Real-time system health, database status, and uptime verification.
- `GET /api/v1/pmpml`: Public bus transit timetables and route connections.
- `GET /api/v1/transit/directions`: Multimodal route calculation between Pune landmarks.
